WTO | dispute settlement - find disputes cases
Follow disputes and create alerts
This page is designed to help you find and follow disputes meeting criteria that you specify. Use one or more of the drop-down menus below to specify search criteria, then click search. You will be presented with a list of disputes matching your criteria.
You can then create email alerts to notify you when new documents are circulated for these disputes.
You can also save your search. It will then appear in
, where you can view the search results, or edit or delete the search.
You need to enable JavaScript to see this page correctly
